items.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021
items.q: I went to the conservatory and studied under Delacluse, the clarinetist

ctx.x: You could have decided at the time, after World War II bop was starting to become, you know, the way to play I guess. And you were associated a little bit with James Moody. Were you looking for something else besides bebop?
No, I was playing music, so I went to the conservatory and studied under Delacluse, the clarinetist and it was getting my technique up and classical music and everything. All music.
